title: Register a new project
prompt:
As a Project Lead,

I want to register a new project with its basic details,

So that team members have a shared workspace to track our upcoming deliverables.

2. Acceptance Criteria (The "Confirmation" / ATDD)
This is where your UI specifics and navigation rules live:

Scenario: Successfully creating a valid project

Given I am on the project creation screen,

When I submit a project with a valid Name and optional Description,

Then the project is saved to the system,

And I am redirected to the landing page,

And a confirmation message confirms the project was created.

Scenario: Validation failure

Given I am on the project creation screen,

When I attempt to submit without entering a Name,

Then the submission is prevented and an inline validation error indicates that Name is required.

tasks.text: The project is stored in the postgres database
